mode: four draft remakes, no project application
delivery: individual 32x32 transparent PNGs and a 64x64 2x2 sheet in user-specified order
constraints: provided palette only, two-pixel outline, minimum two-pixel transparent margins, simplified design

tasks.name: 독한 술기운
tasks.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: ONE tiny 32x32 fantasy roguelike inventory relic icon, a clean remake of the existing icon.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: preserve its recognizable object design, general proportions and orientation while simplifying. Input image 2 is a STYLE reference only: match its chunky square pixels, broad flat connected color areas, clean stepped curves, strong charcoal contour and restrained highlights. Do not copy the boot or wing shape. Input image 3 is the allowed COLOR PALETTE, not an object to draw.
Logical canvas EXACTLY 32x32. Deliberately coarse pixels, not a high-detail picture reduced later. A consistent TWO logical pixel thick #363232 charcoal outline around the full silhouette. Every visible pixel INCLUDING OUTLINE stays within x=2..29,y=2..29, so leave at least TWO transparent logical pixels on all four sides. Preserve natural proportions, never stretch to fill the square. Make the small object fill the available area comfortably without losing the margins.
Use a few large purposeful color clusters, one or two simple shading planes. Absolutely no gradients, dithering, fine texture, speckling, decorative engraving, realistic gloss, anti-aliasing, blur, cast shadow, external glow, free particles or motion streaks. No added flames, electricity, wings, eyes or face.
Background genuinely transparent. Exactly ONE isolated centered icon. No text, number, label, grid, frame or scene. Enlarged rendering must look like an integer enlargement of a low-resolution sprite with uniform square pixels.

Subject: FROTHING ALE MUG, preserving the existing target. A compact sturdy tan-brown wooden drinking mug with a small stout handle on the RIGHT and a large soft LOBED MASS of pale foam rising from its mouth. Foam and mug join into one clear silhouette. The lower mug stays broad and solid, with one simple pale band near the lower middle and a darker base; no many stave lines or little rivets. Keep foam as two or three large connected rounded lobes, not dozens of bubbles. The handle is short, thick and legible. It should still look like the same beer mug relic.
Use ONLY these SIX colors including outline: #363232 charcoal outline; #8A5E40 dark brown; #D49C73 tan; #E9CEA1 light warm tan; #F1E9D4 cream foam shade; #F2F9F8 pale foam. Use all six in flat clusters, with pale foam concentrated at the top. No tiny colored flecks in the foam.
